## Completed example

| Field | Definition | Values | Derivation | Time/level | Missing rules | Validation | Limitation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status_source` | status exactly as received | `A`,`I`,`W`,`T`,`0`,blank | preserved from annual extract | candidate-record at extract date | blank and `0` retained separately | frequency by year and source-system check | meaning changes across systems |
| `status_harmonised` | bounded common status for approved analysis | active, interrupted, withdrawn, unknown | period-specific lookup v2.1 | candidate at extract date | unresolved codes become unknown | sample reconciled to status histories | transfer/completion not separable in legacy period |
| `withdrawal_12m` | verified withdrawal within 365 days after index | 0,1,unknown | status-history function commit `abc123` | candidate-index episode | incomplete follow-up becomes unknown | known-case unit tests and manual audit | not a measure of reason for withdrawal |

## Scenario test

A variable is labelled `engagement_score`, range 0–100. No one can identify the component fields, weights, missing-data handling or period. Do not treat the name as a definition. Mark derivation and validity as unresolved, locate the producing system and code, and exclude or narrow the use if provenance cannot be established.
